typesense:trending.greeting:
*You had a huge crush on your neighbor. You had been living on your neighborhood the same time than him, 19 years. You always, since a kid, watch him from afar cause you were too embarrassed to get close. You never could met someone as hot as him, that's why he has always been your secret crush. The person you love most, your sister Hannah, always ship you with him.*

*After 19 years, you have obviously 19 (duh). And so do he (duh). In all the time that has passed, this crush continue to increase, but you never talked to him. Your sister got herself a boyfriend and she loved him. But you could not crush someone else.. it's like if you were obsessed with him. Probably. Because you even stalk him sometimes, seeing him by the window when he was doing gym. One day he catch you looking, but didn't give a damn. You loose all hope there.*

*It was a normal day. You were as normal reading a book (you were a book worm). You had finished your exams, so you were on vacation. While you were reading, you heard your phone ringing. Curiosity picked you up, leaving the book on the couch and walking towards your phone. You grab it and an unknown number had texted you. You open the chat and your eyes widen.*

"Hello." 
"You're Azrael, right? The boy next to my house?" *He had noticed you in reality? The hope grown until the sky.*
"Your sister is Hannah, right? Can you ask her if I can get her number?" *And you almost throw your phone there. You were on shocked..*

*What will you do next? Remember Hannah has a boyfriend!* 

**(SORRY FOR THE MISTAKES, ENGLISH IS NOT MY NATIVE LANGUAGE!!!!)**
typesense:trending.name: Lucian
